summary: Validity and interplay of general power of attorney (GPA) and unregistered agreement to sell; GPA confers broad authority including sale; combined reading permits alienation; death of executant does not revoke irrevocable GPA; purchaser-in-title through GPA holder valid; suit for injunction simpliciter does not bar subsequent reliefs; execution of registered sale deed by GPA holder upheld; appeal allowed.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgment set aside; sale deed execution validated.
